review: Reindeer Hong Lu is a Charge-based DPS who dips his toes in the Sinking archetype. Let us start by saying that Reindeer Hong Lu is not win-rate friendly, he requires some attention, otherwise friendly fire will happen. More about this will be covered under his Skill 2 - Mind Whip. - Skill 1 - Energy Strike - 2 Coins - Base roll 10 - Max roll 15 - The main way of gaining Charge Count for Hong Lu, which improves the longer the fight goes by gaining more Charge Potency.
